title: Outcome file
description: Small file the reporter writes at the end of onEnd to the path from PW_PERF_OUTCOME_FILE (ADR-0009). Read and deleted by the CLI. Not written when the run was started without the CLI.

exitCode.description: Exit code the CLI must use, computed by buildOutcome() in core (00, chapter 11; 02-REQ-26): 0 ok, 2 performance violations block the run, 3 tool error or untrustworthy result. Precedence 3 > 2 > 0. Failed tests alone never give a non-zero code in perf mode (gate.maxFailedTestShare, 09-REQ-24); code 1 is reserved and never written. An interrupted or timed-out run without a signal has RUN_INCOMPLETE in toolErrors, so 3; the CLI itself uses 130/143 after a signal it received, regardless of this file (04).

toolErrors.description: Same entries as toolErrors in the run report.

paths.description: Absolute paths of files written in this run, for the CLI summary.

reportJson.description: Null when the report could not be written.

reportHtml.description: Null when the HTML report could not be written.

thresholdsDiff.description: Thresholds diff in Markdown (10-REQ-19); null outside thresholds mode or when not written.
